name: Medium's Harrow Mat
body:
Source The Harrow Handbook pg. 31
Aura moderate necromancy; CL 7th
Slot none; Price 2,500 gp; Weight 1 lb.
Description
This harrow mat allows a harrower to tap into the ancestral knowledge of nearby spirits. If a harrower uses this mat as an additional focus component while casting harrowing or greater harrowing, she treats her caster level as 1 higher. When this mat is used to perform a harrowing (magical or not) over a grave or other burial site, the spirit of the interned body influences the harrowing; for each card drawn related to the past, the harrower can draw from the deck twice and choose which card to place.
Construction
Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, speak with dead; Cost 1,250 gp
